svg.title: A year by the water: the world shortlist
svg.desc: World map showing Mauritius as the current base, Indonesia and Fiji as leading candidates, and Peru, South Africa, Western Australia, New Zealand and Hawaii as alternatives. Markers identify approximate areas rather than exact surf breaks. Switzerland is marked for a visit and Hungary is labelled Home, maybe. No travel route is fixed.

g.text: Possible bases and visits along the way.
